notes:
### Hotfix for v1.0.16

**Legal-accept gate threw 500 on Continue.** v1.0.16 read `g.user["id"]` but `require_auth` populates `g.user_id`. Every Continue click raised AttributeError, which Flask returned as an HTML 500 page; the JS `r.json()` then choked on the HTML and surfaced "Network error — please try again." — locking users out of their own dashboard. Fixed.

**Connect button auto-launched the browser.** `server.py` has had a since-V8 auto-open path that pops `http://localhost:5000` whenever the frozen sidecar starts. With the embedded Tauri webview from v1.0.16, this spawned a duplicate browser window every time you hit Connect. Fixed: Tauri now passes `--no-browser` to the sidecar (existing argv flag).

If you were stuck on the legal-accept screen on v1.0.16 — once you upgrade to v1.0.17, tick the three boxes and Continue will work.
